title: JSON to CSV Converter
subtitle: Convert JSON data to CSV format
description: Convert JSON arrays and objects to CSV format for Excel, data analysis, and import into databases. Supports nested data flattening.

features.title: Array Conversion
features.description: Convert JSON arrays to CSV rows

tips: Nested objects are flattened with dot notation
Arrays in cells are converted to comma-separated values
Large files may take time to process
CSV format is compatible with Excel and Google Sheets
